'''''Aurora''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was used by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It participated in the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]].
